SELECT club_id AS clubId ,club_name AS clubName ,c.sport_id AS sportId ,c.recruit_status AS recruitStatus ,c.max_members AS maxMembers ,c.activity_days AS activityDays ,c.activity_start_time AS activityStartTime ,c.activity_end_time AS activityEndTime ,c.image_url AS imageUrl ,c.created_at AS createdAt ,s.name AS sportName ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member m where m.club_id = c.club_id AND m.left_at IS NULL) AS memberCount ,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(rg.name ORDER BY rg.region_id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM club_region cr JOIN region rg ON cr.region_id = rg.region_id WHERE cr.club_id = c.club_id) AS areaLabel FROM club c JOIN sport s ON c.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND c.sport_id = #{sportId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_region r WHERE r.club_id = c.club_id AND r.region_id = #{regionId})
AND c.recruit_status = '모집중'
ORDER BY c.club_name ASC
ORDER BY memberCount DESC, c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.club_id AS clubId ,c.club_name AS clubName ,c.intro AS intro ,c.sport_id AS sportId ,c.recruit_status AS recruitStatus ,c.max_members AS maxMembers ,c.activity_days AS activityDays ,c.activity_start_time AS activityStartTime ,c.activity_end_time AS activityEndTime ,c.image_url AS imageUrl ,c.created_at AS createdAt ,s.name AS sportName ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member m where m.club_id = c.club_id AND m.left_at IS NULL) AS memberCount ,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(rg.name ORDER BY rg.region_id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM club_region cr JOIN region rg ON cr.region_id = rg.region_id WHERE cr.club_id = c.club_id) AS areaLabel ,(SELECT MIN(cr.region_id) FROM club_region cr WHERE cr.club_id = c.club_id) AS regionId FROM club c JOIN sport s ON c.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.club_id = #{clubId}

SELECT m.user_id AS userId ,m.role AS role ,m.joined_at AS joinedAt ,u.nickname AS nickname ,m.club_member_id AS clubMemberId FROM club_member m JOIN app_user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.club_id = #{clubId} AND m.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY (m.role = '동호회장') DESC, m.joined_at ASC
SELECT sport_id AS sportId, name AS name FROM sport ORDER BY sport_id
SELECT region_id AS regionId, name AS name FROM region WHERE parent_region_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM club WHERE club_name = #{clubName} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM sport WHERE sport_id = #{sportId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM region WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND parent_region_id IS NOT NULL
